item.description:
0.6.0

Send and fetch files on a device that has no transfer tools at all.

  • Text transfer — nothing needed on the device. X/Y/ZMODEM need lrzsz on the far end; this needs only base64 and sha256sum. Any file, including archives and firmware, with the checksum compared at the end.
  • Fetch a file the same way, for boards with no network.
  • Rebind almost any shortcut in Settings ▸ Keyboard. Standard Mac keys stay fixed.
  • Send is no longer greyed out waiting for the device, and the progress sheet no longer covers the terminal while it waits.
  • The app comes back after an update, and says that it updated.
